notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Gorbino Land Added to Arena Mode

Increased Optimization 

Spawn limits on secondary enemies

Particle changes 

Changed the music for the Santa Level 

You must first beat Evil Mouth to Unlock Winter Mode/Battle Satna

Bug Fixes
